free_design.Place: The stone terrace of a moonlit manor, lit by paper-shaded lamps overlooking a dark orchard.
free_design.Activity: She holds up a ripe peach to the lamplight, taking a late break after carrying messages to the estate.
free_design.Pose: She pauses in an easy half-stride, her right hand holding the peach near shoulder height and her left hand resting on the terrace railing.
free_design.Framing: A knee-up three-quarter portrait with the lamp, railing, and both hands visible.
free_design.Outfit: An opaque mulberry velvet playsuit with a deep scooped neckline, a looped halter collar and tailored folded shorts.
